article.question: Can free Fast Cleaner help clear Android storage while I keep important photos?

source.title: Free up storage on your Android device
source.fact: Google describes Clear cache this way. Its guide distinguishes this from Clear storage, which deletes app data.

article.comparison: Android cleanup choices before deleting important photos
article.claim_scope: Official guidance supports platform facts. Fast Cleaner descriptions rely on its developer disclosures and existing store/product assets; no independent performance or security test is claimed.
